name: Web Share Target
plain: Lets an installed web app appear in the system share sheet.
meaning: Receives text, URLs and files other apps share, which is how a PWA becomes a share destination.

access.prompt_ui: None until share; app listed in sheet
access.iframe: Same as top level; cross-origin iframes need a permissions policy where listed

data.metric: Lets an installed web app appear in the system share sheet.

fields.name: files
fields.range: files shared, size limited by OS

limits.headline: Can appear in your device's share sheet and receive links, text or files you send it
limits.user_action: You install the web app, then pick it from the share sheet in another app
can: Show up as a choice in the share sheet
Receive text, links or files you share to it
Open the app with what you shared
cannot: See anything until you pick it in the share sheet
Work for a site that is not installed
Work in Firefox, Safari or on iPhone
See what you shared with other apps
limits.differs: Chrome, Edge and Samsung Internet on computers and Android. Safari, Firefox and iPhone do not support it.

story.what_it_is: An installed web app can show up in your share sheet, so you can send things to it.

marketing.name: share_target
marketing.pitch: Lets an installed web app appear in the system share sheet and receive shared text, links and files.

story.for_you: When you share a photo or link from another app, you see the web app in the list. Tap it and it opens with your item ready. It works like any other app.
story.for_makers: Makers get a spot in the share sheet next to native apps, which brings content in with little effort. It is key for social, notes and storage apps. It only works once the app is installed.

use_cases.example: You share a photo from your gallery to a web social app, which opens a new post with the photo ready.
You share a link from your browser to a web notes app to save it for later.
You share a song link to a web playlist app to add it.
You share text from a web page to a web chat to send it to a friend.
You share a product from a news site to a web wishlist app.
You share a screenshot to a web game community app to post a tip.
You share a picture to a web editor to start editing at once.
